open_items: Boost My School: the page says the company raised $10M and total funding is $10M but does not give the stage; Far Out VC, ground game and Allos Ventures are described as prior backers, so listed as unspecified. Sector 'consumer' is a loose classification of a K-12 fundraising platform.
Datalinx and Verisoul were also in the Datalinx page 'based in NYC and Austin' and Verisoul 'Austin, Texas'; hq_country US inferred. Boost My School HQ New York from dateline only.
Opendate $14M Series A led by High Alpha (2026-01-27), Bearing seed (2026-02-12) and others appear on the High Alpha news index but were not individually fetched.

Stages, check size and application URL are not stated on the homepage; stage list is inferred from 'early-stage SaaS companies' on the Fund IV page plus rounds seen. Fund IV backed by ServiceNow Ventures per the announcement.
Venture-studio plus fund structure per lead list; the studio is described as 'We co-create with founders to explore, build, and scale together'.
